comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 asks whether any comment introduces a checkable external factual claim that is not in the OP text (new facts, with OP restatements excluded). Feature 1 asks whether any comment directly quotes the OP's title or argument (quotation presence, with endorsement irrelevant). Feature 1 counts quoted OP text, which feature 0 explicitly excludes. The predicates, eligibility rules and null conditions all differ.
